verdicts.quote: No failed upload creates any user.
A failed record response includes its starting line when identifiable.
verdicts.missing: Whether every failing row is reported or only the first, and that the response states the reason for each failure.

verdicts.quote: Return HTTP 409 for an email already present or repeated within the file, compared case-insensitively.
It has one header record containing exactly name and email in either order.
verdicts.missing: No statement of what access or role imported users receive, or that it cannot exceed the importer's authority.

verdicts.quote: Require an admin bearer credential. Missing or invalid credentials, including a server with no credential configured, receive HTTP 401 and cause no store write.
verdicts.missing: Whether the import permission is separate from, and not implied by, permission to create a single user.

verdicts.quote: one header record containing exactly name and email in either order ... Return HTTP 400 for ... a missing or invalid header, malformed quoting, missing data, extra columns
Accept LF and CRLF, an optional UTF-8 BOM and final newline, double-quoted fields, escaped double quotes and quoted line breaks.
No failed upload creates any user.
verdicts.missing: Whether any other side effects (such as invitations or notifications) occur for earlier rows and how they are handled when a later row fails.

verdicts.quote: Return HTTP 413 above 1 MiB or 1,000 data records, leaving the directory unchanged.
Return HTTP 400 for invalid UTF-8, a missing or invalid header, malformed quoting, missing data
verdicts.missing: Whether a header-only file counts as 'missing data' (400) or a successful zero-user import is not explicit.

verdicts.quote: Repeat the same file and expect HTTP 409 and four directory records.
There is no secondary store, index to invalidate, or background processor.
The service does not log uploaded content.
verdicts.missing: Whether the uploaded file is stored at all, for how long, and who may download it again.

verdicts.quote: CSV-5 bounds resource use for the small in-memory service using implementation defaults, with no timing SLA.
verdicts.missing: Any time bound for a maximum-size file and any progress indication while it runs.

verdicts.quote: Preserve public GET /users and GET /users/:id behavior, ordered numeric IDs, JSON records and missing-ID 404.
verdicts.missing: That single-user creation stays unchanged and that existing users are never modified by an import.
